decay.note: Authored from botanical descriptions of western redcedar: whole flat sprays of scale leaves, 5 to 15 cm long, shed each autumn rusty orange and drying red-brown; small cones 1 to 1.4 cm long. Cedar litter rots slowly. Colours chosen by eye from photographs of cedar litter; numbers plausible, not measured.

look.note: Authored: the drawn look's mean hue at the brightness chosen by eye for this species' litter, the relief the drawing has, and a tile its pieces repeat on unseen. PlantGen's litter tests check the hue and relief against the drawing.
